Noah (docs): kicking off a short "Lightning Migration Cheatsheet" for Optimize toolkit -> single-page, 3 copy-paste bits (batching policy, kv-prefetch SDK, quant tip), a 3-step checklist, and two canonical links. super short. any must-haves?
Isha (eng-sdk): short and literal is best. include a tiny v2->v3 auth diff customers trip on, and an SSE header note for streaming.
Gabe (opt): also put a 1-line rule on auto vs manual batching: when to trust auto, when to cap. keep it prescriptive.
Rae (pm): product blurb: "Expected wins: lower p95 and reduced cost per token; watch short-sequence regressions." one line.
Noah (docs): drafting now. Isha, can you paste a 3-line kv-prefetch SDK snippet we can drop in?
Isha (eng-sdk): sure, use this minimal example:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = cli.generate("summarize: 2 lines max", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Noah (docs): nice. i'll add an italic micro-note: "prefetch helps when >60% prefix reuse". Gabe, your quant 1-liner?
Gabe (opt): put: "int8 for bulk throughput (small quality delta); fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short inputs. Run a 50-sample fidelity check with representative prompts before rollout."
Noah (docs): added. batching JSON (copy/paste ready for Dedicated config):
```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 6144,
    "min_requests": 1,
    "timeout_ms": 25
  }
}
```
Isha (eng-sdk): include this tiny v2->v3 header diff for folks using curl or streaming clients:
```http
# SDK v2 (broken for SSE streaming):
GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Token $OLD_KEY

# SDK v3 (correct):
GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
Accept: text/event-stream
```
Noah (docs): perfect. Gabe, can you write the 1-liner on auto vs manual batching?
Gabe (opt): "Use dynamic_batch=auto for steady steady traffic with moderate SLOs; set manual caps (max_batch_tokens/min_requests) when p95 is critical or traffic is bursty. Rule of thumb: if p95 variance > 15% after enabling auto, switch to manual caps."
Rae (pm): add rollback single-line: "Console -> Deployments -> Routes -> promote previous model variant". keep it in the cheatsheet.
docbot: PR #11555 opened by Noah — "optkit-lightning-migration". CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck: 1 broken link.
Noah (docs): ack, i think the broken link is an old /prefetch path. Isha, canonical URLs?
Isha (eng-sdk): kv-prefetch canonical: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/kv-prefetch. telemetry guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/telemetry-guide. update in PR.
Noah (docs): updated. also added a tiny troubleshooting row: "If latency climbs after enabling prefetch, disable and run a 20-sample smoke eval; check prefix similarity."
docbot: linkcheck re-run passing. PR #11555 merged. :tada:
Rae (pm): nice and concise. can we follow up with a 1-slide micro-deck for CSMs? file a follow-up tickets.
Noah (docs): will create a ticket for a screenshot + deck. final checklist: @Isha confirm snippets/URLs, @Gabe confirm quant/auto lines.
